facts.leaning-hoe: A young man leans on the handle of a hoe, resting both hands and his chin on it.
facts.bush-pentacles: Six pentacles hang on the lush vine bush at the left.
facts.foot-pentacle: One pentacle sits apart at his feet.
facts.gaze: He gazes absently at the pentacles in the bush.
facts.clothes: He wears an orange top, blue sleeves and trousers, and brown boots.
facts.grey-bg: The background is a pale gray.

glosses.leaning-hoe: A rest that stops the work and looks back on what has been done so far.
glosses.foot-pentacle: The one set apart; a share for a new start.

reversedGloss.blocked: The results are slow, and the wait feels stuck.
reversedGloss.excess: Impatience goes too far, trying to harvest what is not yet ripe.

misdescriptions.wrong: All seven pentacles are on the bush.
